messages:
noah park: noticed a new "fragmentation wave" hitting multiple kv shards this morning. memory ramps post-warmup and doesn't plateau; throwing OOMs on shard-x and shard-y. posting follow-up actions here.

maria hsiao: thanks Noah. can you attach the most recent heap and jemalloc dump to S3 and drop a short pprof top snippet here?

noah park: uploaded s3://ooms/1995001234/heap.pb and s3://ooms/1995001234/jemalloc.json. pprof top: 
```
# pprof --text kv-cache.heap
  40.1%  runtime.mallocgc
  27.4%  github.com/redwood/kv.(*Cache).put
  11.2%  github.com/redwood/kv.serialize
```

kevin nguyen: looks like put/serialize path dominates. fragmentation index ~0.46 on affected hosts. short-term plan (Frag Radar quick hits):
- FR1: enable soft-guard per-shard to throttle cache growth (owner: kevin) - ETA 18h
- FR2: deploy "mini-compactor" prototype to staging to evaluate quick wins (owner: samir) - ETA 48h
- FR3: temporary eviction bias for entries >128KB behind flag (owner: noah) - ETA 6h
- FR4: 30s continuous heap sampling for 72h (owner: samir) - ETA 1h

ops-bot: Incident 1995001234-kv-frag-wave created. Priority P1. Assigned: eng-runtime oncall.

samir patel: starting sampler now; sending profiles to s3://ooms/1995001234/profiles. I'll run a short staging compaction bench tonight and post results.

maria hsiao: I'll keep the canonical follow-up doc updated: https://docs.redwood/eng-runtime/frag-radar-followups. I'll also create a small tracking table with owner, ETA, PR, canary scope. scheduling a 20m retro in 5 days to review progress.

noah park: opening FR3 PR (tiny eviction bias) and scoping to canary. PR #6021. will add unit tests for miss-rate guardrail.

kevin nguyen: FR1 spike branch opened; soft-guard will throttle insert when used_mem > threshold and emits evictions/sec metric. will canary 2% -> 20%.

samir patel: staging mini-compactor run completed: fragmentation index dropped 0.49 -> 0.33, CPU +3%. sharing quick dashboard /dash/kv/mini-compact-jan.

maria hsiao: LT program items to track once immediate mitigations are stable:
- P-A: slab allocator & pooled arenas for common size-classes (owners: kevin + samir) - ETA 6w
- P-B: zero-copy serialization for >64KB values (owner: noah) - ETA 3w
- P-C: weekly synthetic frag job in CI (owner: noah) - ETA 2w

kevin nguyen: adding P-A and P-B to sprint board. will run a short internal spike on arena reuse this week.

noah park: FR3 canary at 2% now. monitoring mem, miss-rate, p95. will escalate if miss rate >2x baseline.

samir patel: sampler live; first diffs look similar to prior incidents, pointing at many small allocations in serialize path. will post diff artifacts to the S3 path.

maria hsiao: please post 1-line updates here at each milestone. I'll update the tracking table and close actions after the retro. tagging this incident as recurring: kv-frag-wave.

kevin nguyen: FR1 canary ready for 2% rollout tomorrow morning. will include dashboards and a kill-switch flag.

noah park: EOD: FR3 merged to canary and stable at 2% for 1.5h with no p95 regression. uploading heap diffs to S3.

samir patel: mini-compactor extended run tomorrow; if stable we can evaluate promoting it to limited prod scope as an opt-in.

maria hsiao: summary for the follow-up doc: FR1(kevin,18h), FR2(samir,48h), FR3(noah,6h), FR4(samir,1h); P-A(kevin+samir,6w), P-B(noah,3w), P-C(noah,2w). retro scheduled in 5 days.

kevin nguyen: will post 24h canary metrics after rollout. locking this thread as canonical tracker.

noah park: thanks all. will follow up with heap diffs and CI repro artifacts.

maria hsiao: closing thread for now; will reopen if new OOMs surface or canary regresses.
